items.description:
Bidniz Technologies is a Microsoft technology partner in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, that describes its aim as empowering South African businesses to run at peak performance through tailored, secure solutions. Its services cover modern workplace, CRM and sales enablement, business intelligence, cybersecurity and compliance, cloud migration, managed services, application development and consulting.

Its Microsoft practice centres on Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Defender for Business, Microsoft Entra, Intune and Power BI. The company names legal, financial services, manufacturing and healthcare among the sectors it serves, and it is a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider. It is based at Park Lane West on Bancor Avenue, and it suits organisations that want Microsoft-based systems planned, secured and supported by one local team.

Biz Evolution is an accounting, tax and business support firm in Shere, Pretoria East. Its services include bookkeeping, payroll, tax returns, VAT, company registrations and CIPC services, including beneficial ownership filing and company reinstatement. It also helps clients with SARS matters such as verifications, audits, objections and appeals, and with BEE affidavit assistance and import and export licences.

The firm says its team brings practical experience in accounting, tax and business support. Clients describe what they need, and the firm explains what must be done and then takes it from there. Its website lists SAIPA, SAIT and CIBA affiliations. The office is at Lombardy Business Park on Cole Road, and the firm suits individuals, entrepreneurs and small businesses that want compliance handled together with their books.

items.description:
Bluline Chartered Business Accountants is a Pretoria accounting firm founded in 2021, providing accounting, tax, secretarial and financial statement services to South Africa's growing small businesses. Its services include consulting, taxation, secretarial work, financial statements and support with accounting software, and the firm works with clients in Pretoria and Johannesburg.

The firm describes its approach as built on expertise, integrity and collaboration, and says it aims to guide businesses toward financial goals that go beyond their starting point. Its website offers a free consultation for prospective clients and publishes a blog on accounting topics. The firm is based in Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, and suits business owners who want jargon-free accounting and tax support.

Bosch Car Service Centre Pretoria is a 5-star RMI accredited vehicle workshop in Gezina, Pretoria, equipped with the latest diagnostics tools and trained technicians. Its services include minor and major servicing, cambelt replacement, brake and clutch repairs, diagnostics, auto electrical work, suspension, air conditioning, wipers, batteries, lights, wheels and inspections.

The workshop offers a 160-point Bosch car inspection on request, and customers can book a service through the website. It publishes gearbox maintenance updates on its blog. The workshop is on Steve Biko Road in Gezina, and it suits motorists who want factory-standard servicing and diagnostics from an accredited workshop with trained technicians.

items.description:
BR Rekenmeesters is a full-service accounting firm at 44 Hoogenhout Street in Sinoville, Pretoria, with a Cape Town service also available. It serves individuals, companies and trusts with tax registrations, tax return completion, payroll and monthly salary, VAT and UIF calculations, financial statements, CIPC administration, business plans and financial and tax advice.

The firm says it has more than 700 clients and has been in business for more than 30 years. It presents itself as the first accredited firm to register as a fully accredited training centre, and it supports clients using accounting software such as Xero, Pastel and Sage. Its website is in Afrikaans. The practice suits individuals and businesses of all sizes that want their accounting and tax work handled in one place.

items.description:
Bright Packaging and Raw Materials is a Centurion supplier of packaging, raw materials and equipment for entrepreneurs and small businesses making personal care, cosmetic, household and specialty products. Its range includes glass and plastic packaging, closures, pumps, mist sprays and pipette droppers, along with oils, butters, waxes and chemicals.

The company also sells equipment such as balance scales, filling machines, mixers, sealing machines and coding and printing units. It offers contract manufacturing of personal care, cosmetic and home fragrance products made in South Africa, from formulation to finished product, and it has more than 90 five-star reviews. It ships to anywhere in South Africa and neighbouring African countries. The business is in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, and suits small brands and makers who need materials and equipment in one place.

BusinessNeeds Online is a Pretoria consultancy that helps South African entrepreneurs set up, structure and run their companies. Its company services include CIPC and dti registrations, which run through an online system that sends SMS and email updates, along with annual returns, corporate amendments, trademarks and compliance support.

On the accounting side it covers SARS IT14 (ITR14) and IRP6 tax returns, monthly bookkeeping and financial statements, VAT returns and registrations, UIF and PAYE returns and registrations, and payroll. The firm offers a free tax clearance certificate service. The business is based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, and suits entrepreneurs and small companies that want company setup, tax compliance and bookkeeping under one provider.

items.description:
Bvumbi Ready Mix is a black-owned, youth-led ready-mix concrete company founded in 2019 and supplying concrete made to each client's specifications for builders, engineers, developers and architects. Its ready-mix range runs from 10 MPa to 60 MPa, and it offers concrete pumping with mobile and stationary pumps for large projects and hard-to-reach sites.

The company offers a free site inspection, with advice on concrete choices, volume calculations and delivery access at no cost. Its stated mission is to create jobs and empower communities while providing an impeccable service. The branch serves Akasia and the wider Pretoria North area, and it suits contractors and builders who need reliable mixes and fast placement on site.

C.A and W Services CC is an IT services company in Eldoraigne, Centurion, with more than 30 years of experience helping clients get the best from their IT infrastructure. Its work covers Microsoft Windows workstations and servers, Linux servers, Docker environments, and on-site and remote support, with maintenance and service offered on contract or on an ad hoc basis.

Its application design practice builds full-stack solutions with the Microsoft .NET Framework and .NET Core, including API components that integrate with Sage Business Online and Sage Pastel Partner. It also works with C#, Angular, SQL Server and Postgres, and it provides consulting on the planning, implementation and maintenance of IT infrastructure. The company suits businesses that want extra IT resources without the cost of hiring and training more staff.

Carbon Press is a Pretoria printing company that specialises in self-carbonised NCR books, including quotation, delivery note, invoice, receipt, job card and visitor books, along with snap sets, note pads, prescription pads and desk pads. It offers low-volume NCR printing and also prints digital and full-colour jobs.

Other printing includes business cards, tent and wall calendars, letterheads and flyers, and the company offers die cutting, laminating, numbering and perforating. The company says it aims to give clients the best of what its printers can offer, with a focus on quality and customer service. The works is at Eland Street in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, and it suits small businesses and practices that need forms, stationery and printed marketing material.

Castor King Products trades as Forklift and Mining Spares from Van der Hoff Road in Zandfontein, Pretoria West. The business sells new and used forklift spares, forklift sales, new and refurbished units, forklift rentals, repairs and maintenance, and it says it is one of Africa's largest forklift breakers serving Southern Africa.

The company was started around 30 years ago as a forklift business, and it now stocks mining equipment and older forklift models on its four hectares of land. Its spares stores and a fully fledged workshop with five working bays serve the industry, and the team's combined experience in the sector is put at 70 years. The business suits warehouses, mines, contractors and forklift owners who need spares for both old and current models.

Centurion Ice Cream and Sweets is a factory ice cream shop in Bronberrik, Centurion, known for ice cream cakes, party packs, dipped cones, sorbet and ice cream tubs, sticks and lollies, Italian kisses and tartufo. It also sells premium dry ice for events, deliveries and cooling.

The shop delivers within Centurion and offers bulk order deliveries in Pretoria and Midrand. Customers can also collect their orders from The Foodworks in Hennopspark or HiQ Midstream during business hours. Party packs can be designed around a theme, and orders can be placed online or through WhatsApp. The shop sits on the corner of Kilkenny and Kildare streets, and it suits families planning celebrations and businesses that want desserts or dry ice delivered.

Chalwil Engineering is a Pretoria engineering workshop in Rosslyn that carries out motor engineering, repairs and precision CNC work. Its motor engineering covers cylinder heads, engine blocks and cranks, and gear spline and coupling teeth repair, while its machining work includes linebore, general turning and milling, and wire cutting.

Its CNC services use a 5-axis machine centre and a CNC lathe for one-offs and production runs, and customers can send a drawing for the work. The company started in general machining with a strong focus on gear rebuilding, and it says it aims for quality work, clear communication and parts that fit the job. The workshop suits engineers, fleets and industrial users who need machining, repair and rebuild work from one supplier.

items.description:
Clickwise Agency is a digital marketing agency in Menlyn Corporate Park, Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, that helps businesses reach the right audience with the right message. Its services include social media marketing, marketing strategy, online marketing, search engine optimisation, Google Ads, and website design and development. It also offers marketing consulting, RevOps CRM solutions and WhatsApp API integration.

The agency's team includes a Google expert, an SEO expert, a copywriter and an account manager, who work as part of a client's marketing team. It says it takes time to understand each client's goals, challenges and industry before planning a campaign, and its website shows a portfolio and client testimonials. The agency suits businesses of all sizes that want a hands-on marketing partner rather than a simple service provider.

CM Civils is a 100% black-owned multi-disciplinary construction and engineering group based in Pretoria and established in 2000. It offers civil and building construction services, and it is active in property development across industrial, commercial, retail and residential areas. Its services and projects are shown on its website.

The group says its founding principles of hard work, team effort and integrity are visible in every contract it undertakes, and that innovative technology and attention to detail help it meet and exceed client requirements. The company is a member of several professional bodies. Its office is in Tileba, Pretoria, and it suits clients who need a single construction and engineering partner for civil and building projects.

Collaborit is a global asset management engineering company, founded in South Africa in 2004, that specialises in SAP EAM implementation, reliability engineering, predictive maintenance and digital asset management for mining, energy and manufacturing. It describes itself as a global leader that helps organisations improve performance by integrating people, processes, technology and data with the infrastructure they operate.

Its services span SAP EAM services and technologies, infrastructure engineering and construction, asset optimisation and reliability engineering, operational readiness and support, and enterprise data management. The company says it can reduce maintenance costs by up to 30 per cent, increase asset uptime, optimise spare-parts inventory, improve regulatory compliance and extend asset life. It has more than 250 subject matter experts and works in over 20 countries, and it suits asset-intensive operators that want engineering-led support.

Context Africa is a specialist qualitative research and insights organisation in Villieria, Pretoria, with a focus on community-based and participatory research. It makes sense of everyday behaviours, language, habits and choices that traditional research can overlook, and it works with communities so that their voices shape the research process and its outcomes.

Its services include contextual and qualitative research, participatory community engagement, behavioural and cultural insights, and data synthesis with strategic advisory, which combines existing data and real-time intelligence into actionable insights. The organisation describes itself as a context specialist. It suits organisations that want decisions grounded in how people actually live, think and choose.

items.description:
Cornerstone Guest Lodge is a guesthouse in Lynnwood Ridge, east of Pretoria, that officially opened as a guest lodge in June 2003 in a family home built in the early 1970s. Its rooms and suites are individually decorated in different themes, and honeymoon suites are among the accommodation options.

The lodge also hosts conferences, team building days, anniversaries, birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers and kitchen teas. It describes itself as a tranquil and private stay, with the main attractions of Pretoria close by. The lodge suits couples, families and groups who want a more personal guesthouse than a hotel, with a quiet night's rest in the east of the city.

Cosmo Pools is a Gauteng swimming pool company that manufactures fibreglass pools in its own factory in Hartbeespoort and installs them. Its fibreglass pools are installed in five to seven days and carry a 10-year structural guarantee. The company was named National Pool of the Year at the 2025 NSPI awards for fibreglass pools.

The website lets visitors see a fibreglass pool price online, browse a range of popular shapes and receive a detailed quote within about a minute. Its most-installed shapes are compact enough for a typical Gauteng garden and are quick to install. The business is based on Emerald Avenue in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, and it suits homeowners who want a fibreglass pool with a visible price and a fast installation.

The Crawdaddy's brand site describes the group (established 1995, seafood and meat menu, branches list), but the Zambezi Junction branch has no page of its own in the research. A description would be chain-level only.

items.description:
Create Beauty is an online skincare retailer based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, that sells curated Korean skincare from brands including COSRX, Anua, Medicube, Beauty of Joseon, Axis-Y, Celimax, EQQUALBERRY and HaruHaru Wonder. Its range covers cleansers, essences, ampoules, serums, creams and sunscreens, grouped by skin concern for acne-prone, ageing, dry, hyperpigmented, oily and sensitive skin.

The site says its products are tested, authenticated and delivered across South Africa. Shoppers can browse new arrivals and the full catalogue, or pick a routine by skin concern to find products that suit their skin type. The business suits people who want a curated selection of Korean skincare, from cleansers to sunscreens, bought online with nationwide delivery.

Creative Avenue is a design and marketing agency in Boardwalk Manor, Faerie Glen, Pretoria, that says it takes great pride in the quality of its work. Its graphic design services cover corporate identity, stationery, marketing collateral, brochures, campaigns, presentations and packaging, and its branding work includes strategy on positioning, demographics and target audience.

The agency also offers litho, digital, special and promotional printing, banners and exhibition elements, web design and development, online applications, UI and UX design, SEO and social media. It works across branding, marketing and digital channels, and it suits businesses that need one agency to handle both print and online work for their identity and campaigns.

CreditSmart is a financial services company in Monument Park, Pretoria, that helps consumers with credit, debt and financial management. Its debt solutions include debt review, instalment consolidation, debt counselling and debt review removals, and it also offers credit score insights and coaching, credit cover, corporate solutions and short-term insurance.

Credit cover is designed to protect against debt in the event of retrenchment, disability, critical illness or death, and the company offers a free, no-obligation debt relief consultation. It says it has helped more than 60 000 clients better their financial situation and understand their credit. Its threesixty.me service lets clients explore their credit history and the factors that affect their score. The business suits people struggling with debt or who want to protect their finances.

Cure Day Hospitals Erasmuskloof is a same-day surgery hospital on Jochemus Street in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, close to the N1 and designed for patients who need planned day procedures. Its surgical disciplines include dental, ear, nose and throat, general, gynaecological, plastic and reconstructive, urology, dermatology, ophthalmology, orthopaedic, gastroenterology, maxillofacial and oral surgery, and pain management.

Procedures are performed by specialist doctors with qualified nursing staff, and the hospital describes itself as child-friendly, with safe parking and a relaxed environment. Its website includes a find-a-doctor page, pre-admission information, events and features on its specialists. The hospital suits patients who need planned same-day surgery close to home in the east of Pretoria.

Curro Hazeldean High School is a Curro high school in Hazeldean, Pretoria, teaching Grades 8 to 12 under the national CAPS curriculum. Its approach is project-based learning and self-discovery, with research, experiments and assignments that go beyond the textbook. Teaching takes place in English and Afrikaans, the school is an IEB school, and specialised subjects include robotics.

Class sizes are limited to no more than 25 learners so that each child can get personal attention, and the school offers school transport as well as boarding options for families who live far away. The school aims to develop learners who can take charge of their own lives and make a difference in society. It suits families who want an IEB school with a focus on academics, physical health and emotional wellbeing.

CV Master is an RMI-accredited automotive repair workshop on Steve Biko Road in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, founded in 1979. It specialises in CV joints and driveshafts, which the workshop describes as its founding specialty, and it also handles engine diagnostics and overhauls, brake systems, clutch and gearbox repair, auto electrical work, wheel bearings and suspension.

The workshop also does air conditioning regassing and repair, testing and repair of electric steering racks, and scheduled fleet maintenance programmes for company vehicles. Its website says it works on all makes and models and promises no hidden costs, and it offers breakdown support across greater Pretoria. The workshop suits motorists and fleet operators in Pretoria North and Wonderboom South who want a long-established workshop for everything under the bonnet and chassis.

DAC Systems is a Microsoft Business Applications and Modern Work Solutions partner, established in 1995 and based in Lyttelton, Centurion. It provides advisory, implementation, licensing and managed services across Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Power Platform and Azure, with the aim of helping organisations modernise operations, standardise critical processes and improve execution.

Its industry practices cover mid-market manufacturing, commercial printing, South African public entities, project-based organisations, retail, and food and beverage manufacturing. The company describes its platforms as secure, scalable and Microsoft-native, and it says it works with clients across Africa, Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and the United States. The business suits mid-sized organisations that want Microsoft business applications and cloud services planned and supported by one partner.

DAFO South Africa, trading as Dafo Vehicle, makes vehicle fire suppression systems for heavy-duty vehicles and equipment, and says each product is built with care from first design to final product. Its range includes the SV-K and SV-V Vulcan fire suppression systems, the PFK electric cabinet fire suppression system, the Forrex suppression agent and linear heat detectors.

The company launched Forrex EVO, which it describes as a sustainable, fluorine-free suppression agent. Its published articles cover the role of fire protection systems in heavy-duty vehicles and innovation in the mining industry. The company's knowledge centre also includes sustainability, quality and environmental policies. The Derdepoort business suits fleet and mining operators that need dependable vehicle fire protection.

Damp Seal SA is a damp solutions contractor in Gauteng, started in 1990 to solve damp and damp-related problems in structures. It offers dampproofing, including tanking, injecting and trenching procedures, water drainage systems, roof treatment on concrete slabs and tile roofs, crack repair, and interior and exterior painting.

The company says it has built up knowledge over 35 years and works with permanent staff, with no sub-contractors or casual labour, so the assessment and the work come from the same team. It describes its work as thorough, neat and secure, and it takes care to protect furniture and floor coverings during painting. The Elardus Park business suits homeowners and property owners in Pretoria and wider Gauteng who have rising damp, leaks or cracks in old or new buildings.

DCK Lighting and Electrical is an electrical supplier in Wierdapark, Centurion, that has traded since its establishment on 1 July 2018. Its range includes SABS-approved electrical gear and Tier-1 solar components for residential and industrial customers, and the company supplies critical components for projects from small residential repairs to large industrial installations.

The team says it brings more than 60 years of combined experience in sales consultation and technical advice, and it combines old-fashioned honest service with modern electrical innovation. The company also has a second branch in Mossel Bay. The Wierdapark branch is at Springbok Street, and the business suits homeowners, electricians and industrial buyers who want electrical products and technical guidance from one supplier.

Digital Hippo is a digital marketing agency in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, that helps businesses from start-ups to enterprises win more clients online. Its services include Google Ads management and pay-per-click advertising, social media advertising on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn, content writing and optimised blogs, website design with a UX focus, SEO and complete digital marketing strategy.

The agency says its aim is to make digital marketing simple and affordable, and it works with businesses that want to reach the first page of Google for their services and products. Its website includes case studies and a blog. The business is focused on generating leads, and it suits companies that want their search, social and website work managed by one team.

Digital Humanity is a design and development agency in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, that crafts high-performance websites, apps and software solutions with user-first design and future-ready scalability. Its services include planning and strategy, UX and UI design, web and mobile development, quality assurance and testing, and ongoing support after launch.

The company says it has delivered more than 50 projects with a team of more than 30 members spread across seven countries, and its website reports a 98 per cent client satisfaction rate. Its case studies and insights section shows its work in more detail. The agency suits organisations from start-ups to established enterprises that need a digital product built with care and then supported over time.

items.description:
Direct Debit is a PASA-registered payment collection bureau in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, that provides automated debit order collection software and an API. Its services include debit order collection by EFT and DebiCheck, recurring credit card payments, account verification, and an e-mandate that customers can sign electronically on a website, app, tablet or phone.

The company has 18 years of experience in debit order collection. Its account verification service helps reduce fraud, DebiCheck gives upfront authentication that reduces unpaid debits and disputes, and collections can be paid directly to any bank account. The company suits businesses that collect recurring payments and want those collections automated, secure and easy to reconcile.

items.description:
Dream Supreme Properties is a real estate agency in Annlin, Pretoria, started in 2001. It says it has a great deal of experience in the property market in the Pretoria region, and it reports winning several awards as a best agency. The agency is a member of the TeamWorxs Group Mandate Services network, which lets it connect clients with agents across South Africa, from Musina to Cape Town.

Its services cover buying, where a team handles property hunting, price negotiations, mortgage offers and legal paperwork, and selling, where agents prepare, price and advertise a property. It also offers free property evaluations, online or in-person consultations and viewings arranged through online booking. The agency suits buyers and sellers in Pretoria who want local knowledge and help at every stage of the sale or purchase.
